title: Sequencing: training modules
bodyMd:
Five training modules run once each in a fixed five-slot timetable.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Access, Records, Safety, Ethics, Practice.

- Safety must occur after Access and before Practice.
- Records must occupy position 2 or position 4.
- Ethics and Safety must not occupy consecutive positions.
